name: Whores
overview: Scripture warns against the destructive influence of those who lead others into sin, often symbolized by the 'strange woman' or corrupt figures, highlighting the peril of moral decay when foundational righteousness is undermined. The righteous are called to discern and avoid such corrupting influences, as a good tree produces good fruit while a corrupt one yields evil. God's commands emphasize unwavering faithfulness and the preservation of godliness, recognizing that the removal of the righteous is a merciful act to spare them from coming evil.
